subject: Q4 Fish Pricing, proposed numbers
snippet: Carlton, following up from Tuesday's call. Sending the Q4 price sheet so we can talk it through.
body:
Carlton,

Good talking Tuesday. Here are the Q4 numbers I floated:
- Atlantic salmon: $9.20/lb (up from $8.60)
- Cod: $7.85/lb
- Littleneck clams: $0.42 each
- Black bass (when running): market

Diesel and Hunts Point fees are killing me but I want to keep Eleanor's on the every-Tuesday route. Call me back and let's land this before the fall menu prints.

Kevin
Atlantic Seafood Supply

subject: Re: Q4 Fish Pricing, proposed numbers
snippet: Kevin, salmon at $9.20 is a stretch with the fall menu. Can we hold at $8.90 if I commit to volume?
body:
Kevin,

Appreciate the sheet. Salmon at $9.20 is a tough jump right when the Grilled Atlantic Salmon is $29 on the menu. If I commit to standing weekly volume through Q1, can you hold salmon at $8.90 and keep cod where it is?

Cod and the clams I can live with. Let's talk Tuesday.

Carlton

subject: Tuesday order, what's running
snippet: Morning Carlton, black bass is gorgeous this week and the day-boat cod is in. What do you need?
body:
Morning Carlton,

Black bass is gorgeous this week, day-boat cod just landed. Salmon steady. Want me to put you down for the usual cod and salmon plus a case of littlenecks for the chowder?

Give me the count by 10 and it's on the truck for tomorrow AM.

Kevin

subject: Dry-aged NY strip, Wed delivery confirm
snippet: Carlton, confirming the dry-aged strips for Wednesday and the short rib for the pot roast.
body:
Carlton,

Confirming Wednesday's delivery:
- 6 dry-aged NY strips (for the Grilled NY Strip)
- 40 lb chuck/short rib for Eleanor's Pot Roast
- Ground chuck for the Tavern Burger

Invoice to follow. Saturday delivery same as usual.

Frank Russo
Empire Meat Purveyors

subject: Tue/Thu/Sat produce + fall squash
snippet: Hi Carlton, Brussels sprouts are excellent right now and butternut squash is coming in for the fall menu.
body:
Hi Carlton,

This week's standouts: Brussels sprouts (perfect for the Crispy Brussels), rainbow carrots for the Maple Roasted Carrots, and the first butternut squash is in if you want to test fall specials.

Usual Tue/Thu/Sat AM drops. Let me know quantities.

Maria Delgado
Greenmarket Produce Partners

subject: American craft wine tasting, fall lineup
snippet: Carlton, attaching the Finger Lakes Riesling and a few Oregon Pinots for the fall tasting series.
body:
Carlton,

For the next American craft wine tasting I'd suggest leaning into Finger Lakes Riesling, a couple of Willamette Pinot Noirs, and a California old-vine Zinfandel. I can do a by-the-glass program in your $12-18 range and bottles up to $120.

Want to schedule a sit-down to taste through? I'm flexible.

Claire Bennett
Hudson Valley Wine Imports

subject: June books + payroll
snippet: Hon, I ran payroll in Gusto and the June P&L is close to done. Food cost ticked up, want to look together?
body:
Hon,

Payroll's done in Gusto for this run. June P&L is almost finished, food & bev cost ticked up about 2 points, probably the fish. Can we sit down Sunday after pickup soccer and go through it before I send anything to Harold?

Also Sarah needs a check for gymnastics by Friday.

Love,
Ellen

subject: Re: June books + payroll
snippet: Sunday works. The 2 points is the salmon, renegotiating Q4 with Kevin now. I'll write the gym check tonight.
body:
Sunday after soccer is good. The 2 points is almost all the salmon, I'm in the middle of the Q4 renegotiation with Kevin so it should settle. I'll write Sarah's gymnastics check tonight.

Love you,
Carlton

subject: Fall menu tasting + Montauk Sunday?
snippet: Bro, I want to run the fall menu tasting Thursday before service. Also Montauk this Sunday if the weather holds?
body:
Carlton,

Let's do the fall menu tasting Thursday at 3 before pre-shift. I've got a clay-pot short rib I want you to try and a new cod prep.

Also, Montauk Sunday if the weather holds? Stripers are running. We can be back before your pickup soccer.

Daniel

subject: FaceTime Saturday + Christmas
snippet: Carlton dear, Saturday 10 as always? And I'm planning to come down for Christmas. Tell the children I love them.
body:
Carlton dear,

Are we on for FaceTime Saturday at 10? I want to hear how the children are.

I'm planning the train down for Christmas, I know the tavern is closed the 25th, so we'll have a proper family day. Give my love to Ellen, Alex and Sarah.

Love,
Mom

subject: Astoria Prep, 7th Grade Conferences
snippet: Dear Mr. and Mrs. McGee, parent-teacher conferences for 7th grade are scheduled. Please sign up for a slot.
body:
Dear Mr. and Mrs. McGee,

Parent-teacher conferences for 7th grade will be held the week of October 12. Please sign up for a slot for Alexander through the parent portal. Mr. Delaney (Math) and Ms. Okonkwo (English) have requested time with all families.

Thank you,
Astoria Prep Academy Main Office

subject: Astoria Prep, Gymnastics Recital Nov 22
snippet: Dear families, Sarah's 4th grade gymnastics recital is scheduled for November 22 at 2 PM in the gymnasium.
body:
Dear families,

The Lower School gymnastics recital will be held Saturday, November 22 at 2:00 PM in the main gymnasium. Sarah's group performs second. Doors open at 1:30.

Warm regards,
Astoria Prep Academy

subject: Fri pre-shift + weekend covers
snippet: Carlton, Friday pre-shift agenda attached. We're booked 140 Saturday already, two large parties. Need a call on the patio.
body:
Carlton,

Friday pre-shift agenda: new fall menu items, the wine tasting promo, and the Hendersons' anniversary table Saturday.

We're at 140 covers for Saturday already with the Ramirez party (12) and a birthday of 8. If the weather holds I want to open all 24 patio seats. Your call.

Sophia

subject: Large party request, 18 people, Oct 3
snippet: Forwarding a reservation request for a party of 18 on Saturday October 3, corporate dinner.
body:
Carlton,

Got a request through the website for a party of 18 on Saturday October 3, corporate dinner, possible prix fixe. They asked about the private feel of the back room. Want me to quote the group menu?

- Reservations (via Sophia)

subject: Eater NY, Astoria tavern roundup
snippet: Hi Carlton, I'm writing an Astoria dining feature and would love to include Eleanor's Tavern and the pot roast.
body:
Hi Carlton,

I'm Julia Diaz, a writer at Eater NY. I'm putting together a feature on Astoria's neighborhood taverns and I'd love to include Eleanor's Tavern, especially the story behind Eleanor's Pot Roast and the new fall menu.

Could I grab 30 minutes by phone or stop in? Happy to use your Calendly.

Best,
Julia Diaz
Eater NY
